package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"testing"

	"github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/internal/testgit"
)

// coverGit runs one git command with the test's own identity.
func coverGit(t *testing.T, dir string, args ...string) {
	cmd := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", dir}, args...)...)
	cmd.Env = testgit.Env(t, os.Environ())
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

// TestCommitsWithItsOwnIdentity commits through the helper.
func TestCommitsWithItsOwnIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	coverGit(t, t.TempDir(), "commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
}
